newsitem.title: UK: Black Sea oil port Novorossiisk shut by high winds.
newsitem.headline: Black Sea oil port Novorossiisk shut by high winds.

text.p: Leading Russian oil export terminal Novorossiisk was closed by high winds and swell late on Tuesday and remained shut on Wednesday morning, a reliable shipping source said.
The 650,000 barrel per day (bpd) Black Sea terminal was closed at 2150 local time, the shipper said.

One crude tanker, the Spetses, suspended lifting its 140,000 tonne cargo of Urals and another five were at anchor outside the port. A 21,000 tonne gas oil cargo and a 25,500 tonne cargo of fuel oil were also waiting to load.
